map.按季度复利计息的定期存款到期金额。: The maturity amount of a time deposit compounded quarterly.
map.定期存款（按季复利）：到期金额 A = P ×（1 + 年利率 ÷ 4）^(4t: Time deposit (quarterly compounding): maturity A = P × (1 + annual rate ÷ 4)^(4t); total interest = A − P; principal-plus-interest multiple = A ÷ P; effective annual rate EAR = (1 + r ÷ 4)^4 − 1, slightly above the same-tenor simple interest, used for deposit and wealth-management return accounting.
map.整存整取到期利息与本息合计测算。: Estimate the maturity interest and principal-plus-interest of a lump-sum time deposit.
map.比较不同存期、不同银行的定期收益。: Compare time-deposit returns across tenors and banks.
map.把季度结息的定期与单利存款做横向对比。: Compare quarterly-compounded deposits with simple-interest deposits side by side.
map.季度利率=2.6%÷4=0.65%。到期=50,000×(1+0.0065)^4: Quarterly rate = 2.6% ÷ 4 = 0.65%. Maturity = 50,000 × (1 + 0.0065)^4 ≈ 50,000 × 1.02626 = 51,313 yuan, interest about 1,313 yuan (about 13 yuan more than the 1,300 simple interest).
map.定期存款到期前支取怎么算息？: How is interest calculated if withdrawn before maturity?
map.提前支取通常按支取日活期利率计息，已结的季度利息是否保留视银行规定。急用钱会损失: Early withdrawal usually accrues at the demand rate on the withdrawal day; whether already-credited quarterly interest is kept depends on the bank. Urgent cash needs forfeit most of the time-deposit interest.
map.自动转存按什么利率？: At what rate is automatic rollover credited?
map.到期自动转存一般按转存日银行挂牌的同期限利率，而非原利率。市场降息时转存利率可能: Automatic rollover at maturity generally uses the bank's posted same-tenor rate on the rollover day, not the original rate. When rates fall, the rollover rate may be lower than before.
